<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

You build ONE unit: `flowspace3 tui` — a modest, genuinely gorgeous ratatui dashboard that a person runs over ssh in a plain terminal and immediately understands: what is indexed, what the daemon is doing RIGHT NOW, and an answer to a question they type. Jordan accepted the POC verdict — ship a modest tui verb, defer React — so this is a real product surface, not a demo. You report to the PM (pij-near-carp), not to prime.

| u3 | DATA, two sources and no third: the CLI's own JSON surface for snapshots (fs3_cli::DaemonClient — call it directly, do not shell out to the binary the way the POC did) and u-w's NDJSON event stream for activity (fs3_core::events types, GET /events). u-w is being built in parallel and you must NOT wait for it: build against a RECORDED NDJSON fixture committed under your tests, and keep the source behind one small seam so the PM's composition step is repointing it at the live stream — that swap is the named composition risk, so make it a one-line change and say where it is. |
| u4 | FORWARD COMPATIBILITY IS YOURS TO HONOUR: an event kind this build has never seen parses as fs3_core::events::EventKind::Unknown. Skip it and keep the stream — never error, never exit. A shipped TUI meeting a newer daemon is the normal case, not an edge case. |
| u5 | DEGRADE HONESTLY when the daemon is down: say so on screen in words a person can act on, keep the UI responsive, retry on a stated interval, and recover when it returns. A TUI that hangs or shows stale numbers as if they were live is worse than one that says the daemon is not answering. Same for a dropped stream: notice the heartbeat gap and reconnect. |
| u6 | ALLOWLIST GRANT, exact: ratatui and crossterm for fs3-cli ONLY, added to the arch allowlist in the same commit as the dependency. Nothing else is granted — no async runtime beyond the tokio already present, no widget zoo. The POC ran on one synchronous draw loop plus worker threads over a channel and started instantly in about 700 lines; that is the bar for both simplicity and speed. |
| u7 | YOUR ONLY EDITS OUTSIDE YOUR MODULE: one `Tui` subcommand arm in crates/cli/src/main.rs, one `pub mod tui;` line, and your two rows in crates/cli/Cargo.toml. Two other coders are in this crate right now; that is the entire collision surface and it is deliberate. Also: `tui` prints no envelope, so it must not disturb emit() — and `cargo test -p fs3-cli --test envelope_goldens` must stay green with the goldens unmodified. |
| u8 | TEST HEADLESS: layout and state logic unit-tested without a terminal (what the POC could not do and paid for); stream consumption tested against your recorded fixture including an unknown kind and a mid-stream disconnect; and a manual transcript at first light. `harness checks` must be green in your worktree without a tty present, so nothing may require one to compile or test. |
